mapper.select: select gt.id, gt.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, gt.seed_no as seedNo, gt.draw_order as drawOrder, gt.group_team_status as groupTeamStatus from basket_tournament_group_team gt inner join basket_team t on gt.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 where gt.group_id = #{groupId} and gt.is_delete = 0 order by gt.draw_order, gt.seed_no, gt.create_time

select r.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName from basket_tournament_registration r inner join basket_team t on r.team_id = t.id and t.is_delete = 0 and t.audit_status = 1 where r.season_id = #{seasonId} and r.registration_status = 3 and r.is_delete = 0 and r.team_id not in ( select gt.team_id from basket_tournament_group_team gt inner join basket_tournament_group g on gt.group_id = g.id and g.is_delete = 0 where g.stage_id = #{stageId} and gt.is_delete = 0 ) order by t.team_name
select count(1) from basket_tournament_group_team where group_id = #{groupId} and team_id = #{teamId} and is_delete = 0

select count(1) from basket_tournament_group_team gt inner join basket_tournament_group g on gt.group_id = g.id and g.is_delete = 0 where g.stage_id = #{stageId} and gt.team_id = #{teamId} and gt.is_delete = 0 and gt.group_id != #{excludeGroupId}
mapper.update: update basket_tournament_group_team set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where group_id = #{groupId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into basket_tournament_group_team (season_id, stage_id, group_id, team_id, seed_no, draw_order, group_team_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.groupId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.seedNo}, #{item.drawOrder}, #{item.groupTeamStatus}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
